meta.title: Gymnopédie No. 1
meta.notation_notes: Mutopia MIDI (PD edition, piece 37): 47 bars of 3/4 from quarter 0, no pickup, MIDI tempo 60 per quarter, key signature 2 sharps. The MIDI does NOT unfold the repeat: bars 1–39 are the first half with its first ending (bars 32–39, closing on D major), and bars 40–47 follow directly as the second ending (printed bars 71–78 in a written-out edition, closing on D minor). The repeated bars 1–31 are not played a second time. Bars 9–12 carry an F#4 quarter on beat 1 in the treble track (doubling the chord's F#4); not checked against a printed edition. Texture throughout: bass dotted half on beat 1, chord on beats 2–3, melody above. MIDI-derived score, not an Urtext.

summary: D major, 3/4, slow (quarter = 60). Every bar is bass on beat 1 and a chord on beats 2–3, one harmony per bar. A four-bar Gmaj7–Dmaj7 sway (IVmaj7–Imaj7, F#4 common in both) carries the theme (bars 5–12, restated 13–21). The bass then steps out (iii–vi–ii) to a borrowed D minor (bar 21). A second melody (22–31) sits over a nine-bar D pedal that alternates Em7, Am (minor v), D7 and Dm7. The first ending (32–39) closes with Mixolydian v7 → I. In this MIDI the repeat is not unfolded: the second ending (40–47) follows straight away and turns to D minor over an E pedal, ending v7 → i.

tricks: Bars 1–16: only two chords, Gmaj7 and Dmaj7, one per bar. They share F#4, so the right-hand chord barely changes while the bass swings G2–D2.
Bass on beat 1, chord on beats 2–3: the whole piece uses this slow waltz texture with about two octaves of empty space between bass and chord.
Bar 6: melody C#5 over Dmaj7 puts the major seventh on top, the piece's signature colour.
No leading note at the cadences: minor v (Am, Am7) replaces V in bars 22, 25, 28, 30, 38 and 46.
Bars 21 and 27: D minor appears right next to D major (borrowed i, i7), so the mode keeps shifting under the same bass.
Bars 23–31: nine bars of tonic pedal D2 under Em7, Am, D7 and Dm7.
Bars 40–47: the second ending replays the first-ending shape with F natural over an E pedal and closes in D minor.

loop_candidates.why: Gmaj7–Dmaj7 ×2 with no melody; bar 4 Dmaj7 returns to bar 1 Gmaj7 exactly as in the piece.
Full theme over the sway; bar 12 Dmaj7 → bar 5 Gmaj7 is the written return (bars 12 → 13).
Em7/D–Em7/D–Am/D–D7 over the D pedal; D7 back to Em7/D keeps the pedal, but the melody seam needs listening.

hook_candidates.why: The famous opening melody F#–A | G–F#–C# | B–C#–D | A over IVmaj7–Imaj7.
Gmaj7 → Dmaj7 bass-and-chord cell; recognisable without the melody.
Am7 → D modal cadence (first ending close).

kpop_uses.why: Bars 1–4 / 5–12: the Gmaj7–Dmaj7 sway at quarter = 60 (or double-time feel at 120) gives a soft bed with a lot of room for a vocal.
Bars 17–21: bass steps F#m–Bm–Em–Em7 to borrowed Dm(add9) under one held note; the shift to minor builds tension before a chorus.
Bars 22–31: D pedal with Em7, Am, D7 and Dm7 mixing major and minor; suits a hazy, floating bridge.
Bars 32–39 as an outro or final line: rising melody and Am7 → D close without a leading note. Bars 40–47 give a darker minor ending. There is no key lift in the source.

review_flags.reason: Draft split each bar into a "?" bass beat and a beats-2–3 chord. The bass dotted half sounds under the chord, so one chord per bar from beat 1 is used.
Tempo set to the MIDI value (quarter = 60); the draft said 100.
Draft key change D → A at bar 33 removed: no G# and no E–A cadence; A/E (bar 35) moves to iii42, not I. Read as D major through bar 39.
The MIDI does not unfold the repeat: bars 40–47 (second ending) follow bar 39 directly, and the repeat of bars 1–31 is missing. Bar numbers 40–47 here = printed 71–78 in a written-out edition.

D → d treated as a modulation for the second ending, since the piece ends in D minor. Bar 40 itself has no F; the F natural arrives at bar 41. A modal-mixture reading (D Dorian/Aeolian close) is also possible.
Am/D (bars 25, 28, 30) could also be named D7sus2 (D–E–A–C); music21 has no 7sus2 symbol, so it is labelled as minor v over the tonic pedal.
Bars 9–12: treble F#4 quarter on beat 1 doubles the chord F#4; source detail not checked against print.
Cadences in bars 39 and 47 are v7 → I/i with no leading note, so they are labelled tonic_close, not PAC/IAC. Draft IAC/HC candidates in bars 26, 28, 31, 38, 40 and 46 removed (no V present).
